    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">yolo26训练自己的数据集</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong>1.yolo26介绍</strong></span></p>
<p>　　YOLO26 是一个统一的实时视觉模型,它引入了原生端到端推理、更轻量化的检测头、更新的训练方案，以及用于检测、分割、姿态估计、分类和有向检测的任务专用头。</p>
<p>在五个检测尺度上，YOLO26 在 COCO 上达到了 40.9-57.5 mAP，且 T4 TensorRT 延迟仅为 1.7-11.8 毫秒。该论文还报告称，与 YOLO11n 相比，YOLO26n 在 Intel Xeon CPU @ 2.00 GHz 上的 CPU ONNX 推理速度提升了高达 43%。具体参考<a href="https://docs.ultralytics.com/zh" rel="noopener nofollow">YOLO 目标检测与分割 | Ultralytics</a>。除了常见的检测，分割，分类，姿态，旋转框obb外，还支持了深度估计(通过模型计算每个像素到相机平面的垂直距离)，粗略的计算距离还可以。YOLO26&nbsp;通过移除 DFL、实现无 NMS 端到端推理、引入 ProgLoss/STAL 训练策略等创新，在保持高精度的同时实现了极致的轻量化。凭借 2.4M 参数和 5.4B FLOPs 的优异效率，YOLO26 已成为工业检测、农业监测、智慧城市等边缘计算场景的首选基线模型之一。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="846" height="583" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2304751/202608/2304751-20260809121029636-1936245421.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong>&nbsp;2.标注数据与制作数据集</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong>　　</strong></span>使用labelimg标注就行了，这里不罗嗦了，如果使用labelimg选择了yolo格式,直接整理弄成下面格式(待训练数据集)。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2304751/202608/2304751-20260809122057287-1258779484.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li>
<div class="paragraph" dir="auto"><code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-8d822fd1="" data-v-3b9ae98b="">images/</code> 和 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-8d822fd1="" data-v-3b9ae98b="">labels/</code> 下的子目录名必须一一对应（<code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-8d822fd1="" data-v-3b9ae98b="">train</code> 对 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-8d822fd1="" data-v-3b9ae98b="">train</code>，<code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-8d822fd1="" data-v-3b9ae98b="">val</code> 对 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-8d822fd1="" data-v-3b9ae98b="">val</code>）</div>
</li>
<li>
<div class="paragraph" dir="auto">每张图片（如 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-8d822fd1="" data-v-3b9ae98b="">0001.jpg</code>）在对应的 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-8d822fd1="" data-v-3b9ae98b="">labels/</code> 子目录中必须有一个同名的标注文件（<code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-8d822fd1="" data-v-3b9ae98b="">0001.txt</code>）</div>
</li>
</ul>
<h2><span style="font-size: 14px">　　标注文件格式解释:</span></h2>
<div class="paragraph" dir="auto">　　每个 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-8d822fd1="" data-v-3b9ae98b="">.txt</code> 文件包含该图片中所有目标的标注，每行一个目标，格式为：<code class="language-plain">&lt;class_id&gt; &lt;x_center&gt; &lt;y_center&gt; &lt;width&gt; &lt;height&gt;</code></div>
<h2>&nbsp;</h2>
<div class="segment-code" data-v-8d822fd1="" data-v-3b9ae98b="">&nbsp;然后看上面待训练数据集结构图中，还少一个data.yaml。如下:</div>
<div class="segment-code" data-v-8d822fd1="" data-v-3b9ae98b="">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 数据集根目录（可选，用于相对路径解析）</span>
path: /absolute/path/to/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dataset

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 训练/验证/测试图片路径（可以是目录，也可以是图片路径列表文件 .txt）</span>
train: images/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">train
val: images</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">val
test: images</span>/test  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 可选</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 类别数量</span>
nc: 3

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 类别名称列表（索引 0 对应第一个名称）</span>
names: [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">person</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">car</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">dog</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>]</pre>
</div>
<p>　　根据自己的实际去配置。names:也可以弄成字典形式，如下:</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2304751/202608/2304751-20260809122833004-125949447.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>　　我这里使用lablelimg标注时选择了Pascal VOC 格式，得到了xml标注文件，需要转换为yolo格式，转换代码如下:</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> PIL <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Image
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> shutil
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> tqdm <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tqdm
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> random


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> convert_voc_to_yolo(xml_folder, image_folder, output_folder, class_list,
                        train_ratio</span>=0.8, val_ratio=0.1, test_ratio=0.1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                        random_seed</span>=42<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
    将VOC格式的标注转换为YOLO格式（支持训练集、验证集、测试集划分）

    Args:
        xml_folder: XML文件所在的文件夹路径
        image_folder: 图片文件所在的文件夹路径
        output_folder: 输出文件夹路径
        class_list: 类别名称列表，顺序与YOLO的class_id对应
        train_ratio: 训练集比例 (默认0.8)
        val_ratio: 验证集比例 (默认0.1)
        test_ratio: 测试集比例 (默认0.1)
        random_seed: 随机种子，确保可重复性
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 验证比例和是否为1</span>
    total_ratio = train_ratio + val_ratio +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> test_ratio
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> abs(total_ratio - 1.0) &gt; 0.001<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">raise</span> ValueError(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">三个比例之和必须等于1，当前为: {total_ratio}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建输出目录结构</span>
    images_train_dir = os.path.join(output_folder, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">images</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">train</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    images_val_dir </span>= os.path.join(output_folder, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">images</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">val</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    images_test_dir </span>= os.path.join(output_folder, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">images</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    labels_train_dir </span>= os.path.join(output_folder, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">labels</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">train</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    labels_val_dir </span>= os.path.join(output_folder, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">labels</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">val</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    labels_test_dir </span>= os.path.join(output_folder, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">labels</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> dir_path <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [images_train_dir, images_val_dir, images_test_dir,
                     labels_train_dir, labels_val_dir, labels_test_dir]:
        os.makedirs(dir_path, exist_ok</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取所有XML文件</span>
    xml_files = [f <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> f <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> os.listdir(xml_folder) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> f.endswith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.xml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> len(xml_files) ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误: 未找到任何XML文件</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 随机打乱文件列表</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    random.seed(random_seed)
    random.shuffle(xml_files)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 计算各集合的大小</span>
    total_count =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> len(xml_files)
    train_count </span>= int(total_count *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> train_ratio)
    val_count </span>= int(total_count *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> val_ratio)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 剩余的给测试集（处理舍入误差）</span>
    test_count = total_count - train_count -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> val_count

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 划分数据集</span>
    train_files =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> xml_files[:train_count]
    val_files </span>= xml_files[train_count:train_count +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> val_count]
    test_files </span>= xml_files[train_count +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> val_count:]

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建类别到ID的映射</span>
    class_to_id = {name: idx <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> idx, name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> enumerate(class_list)}

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">数据集划分:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  总样本数: {total_count}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  训练集: {len(train_files)} ({len(train_files) / total_count * 100:.1f}%)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  验证集: {len(val_files)} ({len(val_files) / total_count * 100:.1f}%)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  测试集: {len(test_files)} ({len(test_files) / total_count * 100:.1f}%)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  类别列表: {class_list}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> * 50<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理训练集</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">正在处理训练集...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> xml_file <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tqdm(train_files):
        process_single_file(
            xml_file, xml_folder, image_folder,
            images_train_dir, labels_train_dir,
            class_to_id
        )

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理验证集</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">正在处理验证集...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> xml_file <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tqdm(val_files):
        process_single_file(
            xml_file, xml_folder, image_folder,
            images_val_dir, labels_val_dir,
            class_to_id
        )

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理测试集</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">正在处理测试集...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> xml_file <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tqdm(test_files):
        process_single_file(
            xml_file, xml_folder, image_folder,
            images_test_dir, labels_test_dir,
            class_to_id
        )

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成data.yaml配置文件</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    create_data_yaml(output_folder, class_list)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成数据集划分信息文件</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    create_split_info(output_folder, train_files, val_files, test_files)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> * 50<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">转换完成！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">输出目录: {output_folder}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data.yaml配置文件已生成: {os.path.join(output_folder, 'data.yaml')}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">数据集划分信息已保存: {os.path.join(output_folder, 'dataset_split_info.txt')}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> process_single_file(xml_file, xml_folder, image_folder,
                        images_output_dir, labels_output_dir,
                        class_to_id):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">处理单个XML文件并生成对应的YOLO标注</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 解析XML文件</span>
    xml_path =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.join(xml_folder, xml_file)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        tree </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ET.parse(xml_path)
        root </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tree.getroot()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">警告: 解析XML文件失败 {xml_path}: {e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取图片文件名（处理多种可能的情况）</span>
    image_filename =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 尝试从filename标签获取</span>
    filename_elem = root.find(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">filename</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> filename_elem <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
        image_filename </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> filename_elem.text

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果filename标签不存在，尝试从path标签获取</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> image_filename:
        path_elem </span>= root.find(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> path_elem <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
            image_filename </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.basename(path_elem.text)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果还是没有，从XML文件名推断</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> image_filename:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 尝试常见的图片扩展名</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> ext <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.jpeg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.bmp</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.tiff</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]:
            potential_filename </span>= xml_file.replace(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.xml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, ext)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.exists(os.path.join(image_folder, potential_filename)):
                image_filename </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> potential_filename
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> image_filename:
            image_filename </span>= xml_file.replace(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.xml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 默认使用jpg</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取图片尺寸</span>
    size = root.find(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">size</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> size <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            img_width </span>= int(size.find(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">width</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).text)
            img_height </span>= int(size.find(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">height</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).text)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (ValueError, AttributeError):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果无法解析，从图片文件获取</span>
            img_width, img_height =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None, None
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        img_width, img_height </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None, None

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果XML中没有尺寸信息或解析失败，从图片文件中获取</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> img_width <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> None <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> img_height <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
        img_path </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.join(image_folder, image_filename)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.exists(img_path):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                with Image.open(img_path) as img:
                    img_width, img_height </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> img.size
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">警告: 无法读取图片 {img_path}: {e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">警告: 找不到图片 {image_filename}，跳过 {xml_file}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 复制图片到输出目录</span>
    src_img_path =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.join(image_folder, image_filename)
    dst_img_path </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.join(images_output_dir, image_filename)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.exists(src_img_path):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            shutil.copy2(src_img_path, dst_img_path)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">警告: 复制图片失败 {src_img_path}: {e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">警告: 图片文件不存在: {src_img_path}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建YOLO格式的标注文件</span>
    label_filename = os.path.splitext(image_filename)[0] + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.txt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    label_path </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.join(labels_output_dir, label_filename)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查是否有目标需要标注</span>
    objects = root.findall(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">object</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> len(objects) ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果没有目标，创建一个空的标注文件</span>
        open(label_path, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">w</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).close()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    with open(label_path, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">w</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as f:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 遍历所有目标</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> obj <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> objects:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取类别名称</span>
            class_name_elem = obj.find(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> class_name_elem <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">警告: 在 {xml_file} 中未找到类别名称，跳过该目标</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

            class_name </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> class_name_elem.text
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> class_name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> class_to_id:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">警告: 未找到类别 '{class_name}'，请检查CLASS_LIST，跳过该目标</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

            class_id </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> class_to_id[class_name]

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取边界框坐标 (VOC格式: xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax)</span>
            bbox = obj.find(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bndbox</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> bbox <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">警告: 在 {xml_file} 中未找到边界框，跳过该目标</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span>

            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                xmin </span>= float(bbox.find(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xmin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).text)
                ymin </span>= float(bbox.find(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ymin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).text)
                xmax </span>= float(bbox.find(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xmax</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).text)
                ymax </span>= float(bbox.find(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ymax</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).text)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (ValueError, AttributeError) as e:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">警告: 解析边界框坐标失败 {xml_file}: {e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span>

            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 转换为YOLO格式 (中心点坐标和宽高，归一化)</span>
            x_center = (xmin + xmax) / (2.0 *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> img_width)
            y_center </span>= (ymin + ymax) / (2.0 *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> img_height)
            width </span>= (xmax - xmin) /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> img_width
            height </span>= (ymax - ymin) /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> img_height

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 确保坐标在[0,1]范围内（处理标注误差）</span>
            x_center = max(0, min(1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, x_center))
            y_center </span>= max(0, min(1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, y_center))
            width </span>= max(0, min(1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, width))
            height </span>= max(0, min(1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, height))

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查无效标注（宽度或高度为0）</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> width == 0 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> height ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">警告: 在 {xml_file} 中发现无效边界框，跳过</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span>

            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 写入YOLO格式</span>
            f.write(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{class_id} {x_center:.6f} {y_center:.6f} {width:.6f} {height:.6f}\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_data_yaml(output_folder, class_names):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">生成YOLO需要的data.yaml配置文件</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    yaml_content </span>= f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"># YOLO数据集配置文件
# 自动生成 - 划分比例为 8:1:1

path: {os.path.abspath(output_folder)}  # 数据集根目录
train: images/train  # 训练集图片路径
val: images/val      # 验证集图片路径
test: images/test    # 测试集图片路径

nc: {len(class_names)}  # 类别数量
names: {class_names}   # 类别名称列表

# 类别ID映射 (自动生成)
# {dict(zip(range(len(class_names)), class_names))}
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    yaml_path </span>= os.path.join(output_folder, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data.yaml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    with open(yaml_path, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">w</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, encoding=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as f:
        f.write(yaml_content)


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_split_info(output_folder, train_files, val_files, test_files):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">生成数据集划分信息文件</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    info_path </span>= os.path.join(output_folder, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">dataset_split_info.txt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    with open(info_path, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">w</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, encoding=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as f:
        f.write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> * 60 + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        f.write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">数据集划分信息\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        f.write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> * 60 + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        f.write(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">训练集文件列表 ({len(train_files)}个):\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> file <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> train_files:
            f.write(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  - {file}\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        f.write(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n验证集文件列表 ({len(val_files)}个):\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> file <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> val_files:
            f.write(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  - {file}\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        f.write(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n测试集文件列表 ({len(test_files)}个):\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> file <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> test_files:
            f.write(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  - {file}\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用示例</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__main__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置路径</span>
    XML_FOLDER = r<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">C:\data\xml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 替换为你的XML文件夹路径</span>
    IMAGE_FOLDER = r<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">C:\data\images</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 替换为你的图片文件夹路径</span>
    OUTPUT_FOLDER = r<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">C:\data\data_set</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 替换为输出文件夹路径</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 定义类别列表（必须与标注时使用的类别名称完全一致）</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注意：列表顺序决定了YOLO的class_id，0对应第一个类别，1对应第二个，以此类推</span>
    CLASS_LIST = [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">person</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>]  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 根据你的实际类别修改</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 执行转换（使用8:1:1划分）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    convert_voc_to_yolo(
        xml_folder</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">XML_FOLDER,
        image_folder</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">IMAGE_FOLDER,
        output_folder</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">OUTPUT_FOLDER,
        class_list</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">CLASS_LIST,
        train_ratio</span>=0.8,  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 训练集80%</span>
        val_ratio=0.1,  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 验证集10%</span>
        test_ratio=0.1,  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 测试集10%</span>
        random_seed=42  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 固定随机种子，确保结果可重复</span>
    )</pre>
</div>
<p>　　这样将xml变为了txt文件，变为yolo格式了。</p>
<p>&nbsp;　　这里再提供一个通过xml得到类别的方法:</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> pathlib <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Path

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> get_classes_from_xml(xml_dir):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
    从XML文件中提取所有类别名称
    
    Args:
        xml_dir: XML文件目录路径
        
    Returns:
        list: 排序后的类别名称列表
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    xml_dir </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Path(xml_dir)
    classes </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> set()
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> xml_file <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> xml_dir.glob(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*.xml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            tree </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ET.parse(xml_file)
            root </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tree.getroot()
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> obj <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> root.findall(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">object</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
                class_name </span>= obj.find(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> class_name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> None <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> class_name.text:
                    classes.add(class_name.text)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">警告: 处理 {xml_file.name} 时出错: {e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sorted(list(classes))

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用示例</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__main__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    xml_directory </span>= r<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"C\data\xml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 修改为你的路径</span>
    class_list =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> get_classes_from_xml(xml_directory)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">所有类别:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(class_list)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n类别数量: {len(class_list)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 打印每个类别及其索引（YOLO格式）</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\nYOLO类别映射:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> idx, class_name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> enumerate(class_list):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  {idx}: {class_name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>　　通过类别自动生成data.yaml</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> yaml
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> pathlib <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Path

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> generate_data_yaml(classes, output_path=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data.yaml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, dataset_path=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">./</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
    生成YOLO训练所需的data.yaml配置文件
    
    Args:
        classes: 类别名称列表，如 ['cat', 'dog', 'person']
        output_path: 保存路径，默认 "data.yaml"
        dataset_path: 数据集根目录，默认 "./"
    
    Example:
        &gt;&gt;&gt; generate_data_yaml(['cat', 'dog', 'person'], "data.yaml", "./dataset")
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构建配置</span>
    config =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: dataset_path,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">train</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">train/images</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">val</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">val/images</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test/images</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">nc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: len(classes),
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">names</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: classes
    }
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保存文件</span>
    with open(output_path, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">w</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, encoding=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as f:
        yaml.dump(config, f, default_flow_style</span>=False, allow_unicode=True, sort_keys=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">False)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ data.yaml 已生成: {output_path}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">   类别数量: {len(classes)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">   类别列表: {classes}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用示例</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__main__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 方式1: 直接指定类别</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> classes = ['bengbian', 'fanbai', 'qipao', 'quejiao', 'tuojiao', 'xiansun', 'yiwu', 'zangwu']  # 例如: ['cat', 'dog', 'person']</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> generate_data_yaml(classes, "data.yaml", "./dataset")</span>
    
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 方式2: 从XML自动提取类别</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> get_classes_from_xml(xml_dir):
        classes </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> set()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> xml_file <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> Path(xml_dir).glob(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*.xml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
            tree </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ET.parse(xml_file)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> obj <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> tree.findall(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">object</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
                name </span>= obj.find(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> None <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name.text:
                    classes.add(name.text.strip())
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sorted(list(classes))
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 从XML提取并生成</span>
    classes = get_classes_from_xml(r<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">C:/data/xml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">提取到类别: {classes}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    generate_data_yaml(classes, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data.yaml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">./dataset</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-size: 18px">3.预训练权重下载:</span></strong></p>
<p>　　去下载预训练权重（不下载也没关系，训练时会自动检测，没有就自动下载）,如图，根据自己需要下载。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="930" height="675" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2304751/202608/2304751-20260809124602533-1984892680.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong>&nbsp;4.训练</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong>　　</strong><span style="font-size: 14px">最简单的训练脚本如下,根据需要可以在</span></span>model.train<span style="font-size: 14px">配置其他参数，这里不赘述了。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> ultralytics <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> YOLO



</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__main__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Load a model</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> model = YOLO("yolo26n.yaml")  # build a new model from YAML</span>
    model = YOLO(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">./pre_weights/yolo26n.pt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> load a pretrained model (recommended for training)</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> model = YOLO("yolo26n.yaml").load("yolo26n.pt")  # build from YAML and transfer weights</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Train the model</span>
    results = model.train(data=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data_set2/data.yaml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, epochs=500, imgsz=640)</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>　&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;　<img alt="image" width="1155" height="389" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2304751/202608/2304751-20260809131530845-731283173.png" class="lazyload"></p>
