<ol>
<li><img alt="image" width="1158" height="410" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2304751/202608/2304751-20260809131553580-1699557305.png" class="lazyload"></li>
</ol>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong>5.pt推理</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong>　</strong><span style="font-size: 14px">　训练完会得到.pt权重文件，一般使用last.pt或者best.pt。推理脚本如下:</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cv2
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> gc
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> ultralytics <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> YOLO

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> warmup_model(model, device, image_path=None, warmup_iterations=5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
    预热模型
    
    Args:
        model: YOLO模型
        device: 设备 ('cuda' 或 'cpu')
        image_path: 图片路径，如果为None则创建虚拟图片
        warmup_iterations: 预热次数
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">预热模型中...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 准备预热图片</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> image_path:
        warmup_image </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cv2.imread(image_path)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> warmup_image <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">⚠️ 无法读取图片，使用虚拟图片</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            warmup_image </span>= torch.zeros((640, 640, 3), dtype=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">torch.uint8).numpy()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建虚拟图片</span>
        warmup_image = torch.zeros((640, 640, 3), dtype=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">torch.uint8).numpy()
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 多次预热</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range(warmup_iterations):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  预热 {i+1}/{warmup_iterations}...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, end=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        _ </span>= model(warmup_image, verbose=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">False)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> device == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cuda</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            torch.cuda.synchronize()  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 等待GPU完成</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> ✅</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 清理显存缓存</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> device == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cuda</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
        torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
    
    gc.collect()  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 垃圾回收</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ 预热完成</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主程序</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__main__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 检查GPU</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch.cuda.is_available():
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ 使用GPU: {torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        device </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cuda</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">   显存总量: {torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory / 1024**3:.2f} GB</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">⚠️ GPU不可用，使用CPU</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        device </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cpu</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
    
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 加载模型</span>
    model = YOLO(r<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">C:\workspace\yolo_demo\runs\detect\train-5\weights\best.pt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    model.to(device)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 预热模型</span>
    image_path = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    warmup_model(model, device, image_path, warmup_iterations</span>=5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 正式推理</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n开始正式推理...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    image </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cv2.imread(image_path)
    
    t1 </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time.time()
    results </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model(image)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> device == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cuda</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
    t2 </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time.time()
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">推理耗时: {(t2-t1)*1000:.2f}ms</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 显示显存使用</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> device == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cuda</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        memory_allocated </span>= torch.cuda.memory_allocated() / 1024**2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        memory_cached </span>= torch.cuda.memory_reserved() / 1024**2
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">显存使用: {memory_allocated:.2f} MB (分配) / {memory_cached:.2f} MB (缓存)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 6. 打印检测结果</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> r <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> results:
        boxes </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> r.boxes
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> boxes <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n检测到 {len(boxes)} 个目标:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i, box <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> enumerate(boxes, 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
                cls_id </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> int(box.cls[0])
                cls_name </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model.names[cls_id]
                conf </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> float(box.conf[0])
                xyxy </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> box.xyxy[0].cpu().numpy()
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">目标 {i}: {cls_name}, 置信度: {conf:.3f}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  位置: ({xyxy[0]:.1f}, {xyxy[1]:.1f}) -&gt; ({xyxy[2]:.1f}, {xyxy[3]:.1f})</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>　　测试没得问题，这里就不贴图了。</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong>5.onnx推理</strong></span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-size: 14px">　　5.1 pt格式转onnx格式</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14px">　　由于是pt格式，需要转换为.onnx格式。转换代码如下:</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> ultralytics <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> YOLO

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Load a model</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> model = YOLO("yolo26n.pt")  # load an official model</span>
model = YOLO(r<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">C:\workspace\yolo_demo\runs\detect\train-5\weights\best.pt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> load a custom-trained model</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Export the model</span>
model.export(format=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">onnx</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>　　就得到了best.onnx</p>
<p><strong>　　5.2 cpu推理</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cv2
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> ultralytics <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> YOLO

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 加载模型</span>
model = YOLO(r<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">C:\workspace\yolo_demo\runs\detect\train-5\weights\best.onnx</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 读取并推理</span>
image = cv2.imread(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">./data_set/yolo_dataset/test/images/21_1-rectangle.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 预热（忽略第一次加载）</span>
_ =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model(image)

t1</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">time.time()
results </span>= model(image, save=True, project=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">runs/detect</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">inference</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
t2</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">time.time()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">耗时:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,t2-t1) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">耗时: 0.045999765396118164</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保存结果</span>
cv2.imwrite(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">my_result.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, results[0].plot())
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ 结果已保存到: my_result.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 打印检测框信息</span>
boxes =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> results[0].boxes
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> boxes:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n检测到 {len(boxes)} 个目标:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> * 60<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i, box <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> enumerate(boxes, 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
        cls_id </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> int(box.cls[0])
        conf </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> float(box.conf[0])
        xyxy </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> box.xyxy[0].cpu().numpy()
        xywh </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> box.xywh[0].cpu().numpy()
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">目标 {i}:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  类别: {model.names[cls_id]} (ID: {cls_id})</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  置信度: {conf:.4f}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  边界框 (xyxy): x1={xyxy[0]:.1f}, y1={xyxy[1]:.1f}, x2={xyxy[2]:.1f}, y2={xyxy[3]:.1f}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  边界框 (xywh): cx={xywh[0]:.1f}, cy={xywh[1]:.1f}, w={xywh[2]:.1f}, h={xywh[3]:.1f}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  宽度: {xywh[2]:.1f}px, 高度: {xywh[3]:.1f}px</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> * 60<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">未检测到任何目标</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

<p>　<strong>　5.3 gpu推理</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> typing <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Optional

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cv2
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> numpy as np
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> onnxruntime as ort


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> YOLO26Detector:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">YOLO26 ONNX GPU 推理类（端到端无NMS）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
        self,
        model_path: str,
        providers: Optional[list[str]] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> providers: list[str] | None = None,</span>
        conf_threshold: float = 0.25<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        input_size: tuple[int, int] </span>= (640, 640<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    ):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
        Args:
            model_path:     ONNX 模型文件路径
            providers:      ONNX Runtime 执行提供者列表，默认自动选择 GPU
            conf_threshold: 置信度阈值
            input_size:     模型输入尺寸 (height, width)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> providers <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
            providers </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [
                </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CUDAExecutionProvider</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CPUExecutionProvider</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            ]

        self.conf_threshold </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> conf_threshold
        self.input_size </span>= input_size  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> (h, w)</span>

        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建推理会话</span>
        sess_options =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ort.SessionOptions()
        sess_options.graph_optimization_level </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
            ort.GraphOptimizationLevel.ORT_ENABLE_ALL
        )
        self.session </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ort.InferenceSession(
            model_path, sess_options</span>=sess_options, providers=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">providers
        )

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取实际使用的 provider</span>
        self.provider =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.session.get_providers()[0]
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[YOLO26] 模型加载完成 | Provider: {self.provider}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取输入信息</span>
        self.input_name =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.session.get_inputs()[0].name
        self.input_shape </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.session.get_inputs()[0].shape
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[YOLO26] 输入名称: {self.input_name}, 形状: {self.input_shape}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 预热模型</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        self.warmup()

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> warmup(self, iterations: int = 10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">预热模型，确保 GPU 上下文初始化完成</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        dummy_input </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> np.zeros(
            (</span>1, 3, self.input_size[0], self.input_size[1]), dtype=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">np.float32
        )
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[YOLO26] 开始预热 ({iterations} 次)...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        start </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time.perf_counter()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> _ <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range(iterations):
            self.session.run(None, {self.input_name: dummy_input})
        elapsed </span>= (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[YOLO26] 预热完成 | 平均耗时: {elapsed / iterations:.2f} ms/帧</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> preprocess(self, image: np.ndarray) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tuple[np.ndarray, float, int, int]:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
        图像预处理：Letterbox 缩放 + 归一化 + CHW 转换

        Returns:
            input_tensor: 模型输入张量 (1, 3, H, W)
            scale:        缩放比例
            pad_w:        水平方向 padding 像素
            pad_h:        垂直方向 padding 像素
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        h, w </span>= image.shape[:2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
        target_h, target_w </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.input_size

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 计算缩放比例（保持宽高比）</span>
        scale = min(target_h / h, target_w /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> w)
        new_h, new_w </span>= int(h * scale), int(w *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scale)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 缩放</span>
        resized = cv2.resize(image, (new_w, new_h), interpolation=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cv2.INTER_LINEAR)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Letterbox 填充（灰色 114）</span>
        pad_h = target_h -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> new_h
        pad_w </span>= target_w -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> new_w
        top, left </span>= pad_h // 2, pad_w // 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        padded </span>= np.full((target_h, target_w, 3), 114, dtype=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">np.uint8)
        padded[top : top </span>+ new_h, left : left + new_w] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> resized

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> BGR -&gt; RGB, HWC -&gt; CHW, 归一化到 [0, 1]</span>
        blob = padded[:, :, ::-1].transpose(2, 0, 1).astype(np.float32) / 255.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        input_tensor </span>= np.expand_dims(blob, axis=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">0)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> input_tensor, scale, pad_w, pad_h

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> postprocess(
        self, output: np.ndarray, scale: float, pad_w: int, pad_h: int
    ) </span>-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list[dict]:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
        后处理：解析端到端输出 (N, 300, 6)
        格式: [x1, y1, x2, y2, confidence, class_id]

        Returns:
            detections: 检测结果列表
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        detections </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> output shape: (1, 300, 6) 或 (300, 6)</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> output.ndim == 3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            output </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> output[0]

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> det <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> output:
            x1, y1, x2, y2, conf, cls_id </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> det

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 置信度过滤</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> conf &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.conf_threshold:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span>

            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将坐标映射回原图（去除 letterbox padding 和缩放）</span>
            x1 = (x1 - pad_w / 2) /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scale
            y1 </span>= (y1 - pad_h / 2) /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scale
            x2 </span>= (x2 - pad_w / 2) /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scale
            y2 </span>= (y2 - pad_h / 2) /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scale

            detections.append(
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bbox</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [float(x1), float(y1), float(x2), float(y2)],
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">confidence</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: float(conf),
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">class_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: int(cls_id),
                }
            )

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> detections

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> detect(self, image: np.ndarray) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list[dict]:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
        对单张图像执行目标检测

        Args:
            image: BGR 格式的 OpenCV 图像 (H, W, 3)

        Returns:
            detections: 检测结果列表，每项包含 bbox, confidence, class_id
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 预处理</span>
        input_tensor, scale, pad_w, pad_h =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.preprocess(image)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 推理</span>
        outputs =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.session.run(None, {self.input_name: input_tensor})
        output </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> outputs[0]

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 后处理</span>
        detections =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.postprocess(output, scale, pad_w, pad_h)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> detections

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> detect_batch(self, images: list[np.ndarray]) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list[list[dict]]:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
        批量检测（要求所有图像尺寸一致）

        Args:
            images: BGR 图像列表

        Returns:
            每张图像的检测结果列表
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        batch_tensors </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
        preprocess_info </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> img <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> images:
            tensor, scale, pad_w, pad_h </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.preprocess(img)
            batch_tensors.append(tensor)
            preprocess_info.append((scale, pad_w, pad_h))

        batch_input </span>= np.concatenate(batch_tensors, axis=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">0)
        outputs </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.session.run(None, {self.input_name: batch_input})

        all_detections </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i, (scale, pad_w, pad_h) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> enumerate(preprocess_info):
            dets </span>= self.postprocess(outputs[0][i : i + 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">], scale, pad_w, pad_h)
            all_detections.append(dets)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> all_detections


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ===================== 使用示例 =====================</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__main__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化检测器（自动使用 CUDA GPU）</span>
    detector =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> YOLO26Detector(
        model_path</span>=r<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">C:\workspace\yolo_demo\runs\detect\train-5\weights\best.onnx</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        conf_threshold</span>=0.25<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        input_size</span>=(640, 640<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    )

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 读取图像</span>
    image = cv2.imread(r<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">C:\workspace\yolo_demo\data_set\yolo_dataset\test\images\21_1-rectangle.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 单张检测</span>
    detections =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> detector.detect(image)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> det <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> detections:
        x1, y1, x2, y2 </span>= [int(v) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> v <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> det[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bbox</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]]
        conf </span>= det[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">confidence</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
        cls_id </span>= det[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">class_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">类别: {cls_id}, 置信度: {conf:.4f}, 坐标: [{x1}, {y1}, {x2}, {y2}]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 绘制检测框</span>
        cv2.rectangle(image, (x1, y1), (x2, y2), (0, 255, 0), 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        cv2.putText(
            image,
            f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{cls_id}: {conf:.2f}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            (x1, y1 </span>- 5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
            cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,
            </span>0.5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            (0, </span>255<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 0),
            </span>2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        )

    cv2.imwrite(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result_26.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, image)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">共检测到 {len(detections)} 个目标</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>　　贴个效果图吧，如下:</p>
<p><img alt="企业微信截图_17862520931265" width="208" height="255" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2304751/202608/2304751-20260809130835091-490136695.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>小结:&nbsp;</strong>本文介绍了yolo26的从标注到训练到推理的全部流程，别给出实际脚本，关于NMS这一块yolo26是去除了的，如果自己的项目目标检测多个有重叠，且不需要，可以自己写一个NSM，这里不再详述。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>　　本文若存在不做或错误之处，欢迎指出与评论。</p>
